dialogues.speaker: Rhemia
dialogues.text: Different humans exhibit different behaviors. Some wear hats, and others don't. Same for drinking coffee, or being in a hurry...

dialogues.speaker: Rhemia
dialogues.text: I love categorizing them and summarizing the various patterns they follow.

dialogues.speaker: Rhemia
dialogues.text: For example, more people wear hats in the morning than in the afternoon. Do you know why that is?

dialogues.speaker: Rhemia
dialogues.text: From my observations, it seems that people are properly dressed when they head out in the morning.

dialogues.speaker: Rhemia
dialogues.text: But in the afternoon, after a day at work, they stop sweating the small details. They loosen their ties, take off their hats, and run out to the platforms happily.
